notes: Kalshi is a CFTC-regulated designated contract market; opening an account means the venue's identity verification — a person's documents, a person's consent. The job refuses before opening a browser and says the account must be opened by a person (docs/operations/registering-a-venue.md, 'What may not be automated'). Its API terms are unread (ADR 0034), so nothing here should reach the venue at all until the operator has read them.
